title: DS3231 Register Map
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Clocks and Watches with AI
description: An interactive map of DS3231 registers 0x00 to 0x12 with hex, binary, and decoded values, bit-field details, live BCD values from the browser clock, and a decoding quiz.

learningObjectives: Identify which DS3231 register holds each time field
Interpret raw register bytes, including BCD and control bits

keyQuestions: Why must the hours byte be masked with 0x3F?
commonMisconceptions: Every register is stored in BCD (temperature is a signed integer)
The month register needs no masking
assessmentOpportunities: Name the register for the day of the month

controls: Hover and click on register rows
